question: Which of the following is a chemical element with the atomic number 10?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neon **is a chemical element with the atomic number 10.
 
• The electronic configuration of neon-1s__2__2s__2__2p__6.
 __
 
• Atomic Symbol-Ne.
 
• Atomic mass-20.1797 u.
 
 
 
• Neon is a **noble gas.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• It is non-reactive as its shells are full and electrons are not available to readily exchange.
 
• It is under **Group 18 and Period 2.**
 
• The largest use of Neon is in advertising-Neon gas signs.
 
• **Neon glows **a reddish-orange color in a vacuum discharge tube.
 
• Neon is also used to make **high-voltage indicators and switching gear, diving equipment, and lasers.**
 
• It is the** fifth most abundant element** in the universe.
